question: Find the short names of teams that have team attributes with buildUpPlaySpeed between 30 and 35, buildUpPlayDribbling between 50 and 60, and buildUpPlayPassing between 30 and 35, and that belong to one of the bottom 5 leagues ranked by total goals scored across all seasons (i.e., leagues with the fewest goals).
